spots.name: Westcott Bay
spots.notes: Mud bottom, 25–35 ft. Set south of the oyster floats, not among them.

spots.name: Garrison Bay
spots.notes: Anchor off English Camp and run pots toward the middle of the bay.

spots.name: Nelson Bay (Henry Is.)
spots.notes: Found this one in 2024. Sand and eelgrass edge, 40 ft.

spots.name: Mosquito Pass
spots.notes: Current rips through here. Pots walk on big exchanges. Only try at slack.

spots.name: Griffin Bay off Fourth of July Beach
Brown Island south
spots.notes: Close to home but ferry wakes. Mostly females and shorts.

spots.name: Fisherman Bay entrance
spots.notes: Stay outside the spit; shallow inside at low tide.

spots.name: Mackaye Harbor
spots.notes: Long run. Good when the west side is crowded.

spots.name: East Sound (Orcas)
spots.notes: Long run from Friday Harbor. Rarely worth it.
